posts.text: The market has realized the company’s potential and is now more aware of the story, which is why the stock has been sharply rerated. Nuvama’s research coverage and mutual fund participation have also added credibility to the thesis. The Q1 update was stronger as well. They have around 420 prototypes in development, and now it all comes down to how effectively they commercialize them going forward. The key things to monitor will be their expansion plans and order book. They have been working with customers on multiple pilot projects, some of which could potentially translate into large orders.…

posts.community: Aimtron Electronics Ltd (EMS China+1 Global Play)
posts.text: I view this a bit differently. I think the market hasn’t fully factored in that FY27 revenue could reach ₹550–600 Cr, driven by organic growth alongside the ICS revenue contribution (approx. ₹170–180 Cr). With FY27 EPS expected to nearly double, the trailing P/E drops from 78x to a forward P/E of ~40x. For a company growing at a 40–50% CAGR, that puts the PEG ratio around 0.8 to 1.0—meaning it is still attractively valued. Disclaimer: This is my personal view, and I could be wrong. Please exercise caution and do your own research. Disclosure: Invested from an early stage; considered increasing…
